newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico domestic vehicle sales soar -- AMIA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico domestic vehicle sales soar -- AMIA.

text.p: Total vehicle sales for the domestic market in Mexico posted a sharp increase in the first two months of the year compared to the same period a year earlier, the industry said on Monday.
Wholesale sales of trucks and cars totalled 65,072 units in January and February, up 46.4 percent on 1996, a statement by the Mexican Automobile Industry Association said (AMIA).

Retail sales meanwhile notched up a total of 60,049 units for the first two months of the year, an increase of 42 percent from the same period last year, the AMIA said, noting that both retail and wholsale figures included imported vehicles.
Total production of vehicles in Mexico for January and February was 208,967 units, an increase of just two percent from 1996.
Production for the domestic market increased 40.2 percent to 48,389 units in the first two months of the year.
Total production of vehicles for export meanwhile fell 5.7 percent for the same period, but was still much greater than for the domestic market at 160,578 units.
